title: Resonant Link Labels — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Resonant Link Labels's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.title: Every link, and whether it says how
pieces.caption: One square for each of the 2,323 links between pages, coloured by type. Filled squares carry a label saying how the two pages meet; hollow ones only say that they do. 93 percent are filled. *What is real and what is a choice:* Map build of 2026-11-09, links between pages only, so the total differs from the page's 2,940.

verdicts.why: Right, and it does what the sentence cannot: one glance shows the second register in use. One required addition to the honesty line: it explains why the total differs from the page's 2,940 but not why the share is 93 where the sentence beside it says 67.
